understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +. When multiple goals or pieces exist, all goals must be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN and complete the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifts the selected piece by one grid cell, or 3 pixels, in the chosen direction; walls and boundaries can block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks may be moved together with the selected piece when space permits. CLICK selects another selectable piece using its pixel/grid coordinates, allowing pieces to be controlled independently. The movement-blocked indicators are only hints and do not always predict whether movement will succeed.
